notes.title: Haunted House of Doom - out now!
notes.content:
Paul Bird has released a new game called "[b]The Haunted House of Doom[/b]" just in time for Halloween!

The game is a puzzle game where you have to collect objects to solve the puzzles in the house and solve the mystery of [b]The Haunted House of Doom[/b].

Solve the mystery at your own pace. But, there is a horror theme so, the game has a bit of a bite!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/781920/The_Haunted_House_of_Doom/


The game is having positive reviews so far. If you like this sort of game, why not give it a go?

If you like old style adventure games this game might be for you.

notes.title: More spaceworms
notes.content:
Designing the head of one of the spaceworms.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34900619/5fe565afe808052d886680d9a23e8ff8e854be04.png[/img]

I'm thinking once you've killed a space worm, it explodes and new baby spaceworms come out and you have to shrink down and kill those as well. Basically ridding the universe of spaceworms.

So for example once you kill the galactic spaceworms the baby spaceworms might be circling the planets. Etc. and so on.

Also, there might be other enemies.

If you don't kill the spaceworm in time it might destroy the planet.

notes.title: Working on the giant space worms.
notes.content:
Today I'm working on the giant space worms. These are basically snakes that can be found in various places.

Firstly the galactic space worms, fly though space feeding on galactic gasses.

Secondly we have the giant dune worms which burrow inside asteroids.

You can ride on the back of these worms, almost like hitching a ride on a train.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34900619/d897fbf2d96c544c9843f4684aad0b78523b54b9.png[/img]

notes.title: Dev Log
notes.content: This is my new game which I hope to finish by next year. Basically this game will evolve between now and it's release. I obviously have my ideas about how it will go but also, I'm open to suggestions. The next thing on my list is giant worms. Which will include space-worms and giant sand-worms. One thing I've learnt about games over the years is that everyone wants a game with giant sand worms in it.
